NFL Football - Arizona Cardinals at New York Giants

The New York Giants clash with the Arizona Cardinals in Week 4 at MetLife Stadium. The Giants' defense held the Titans to 262 total yards las week, but now must deal with a Cardinals' offense that generated 365 yards in their loss to San Francisco.
NFL Football - Kansas City Chiefs at Las Vegas Raiders

The Las Vegas Raiders host the Kansas City Chiefs at Allegiant Stadium in NFL Week 4. Both teams are unbeaten, sitting atop the AFC West. Las Vegas claimed the last meeting, a 14-12 victory in the last game of the regular season on January 4.
